rationale: AMENDMENT-2 is a sound, bounded, internally consistent governed correction. The factual premise is accurate: DISCOVERY-002 establishes connectors/meta-ads-mcp/server.mjs pre-exists on disk with 313/313 gates green, and the prior plan language asserting both dirs 'do not yet exist' is plainly wrong. The amendment makes a fresh governed decision grounded in the DISCOVERY-002 evidence and AM-43 exclusion authority, not in the prior wording — exactly what the Eye ruling required. Phase B's end state is unchanged (both directories excluded); only provenance semantics change (one added, one formally classified), and that distinction carries no downstream obligation mismatch. The per-directory deferral justification is now explicit and logically sound: cli/ defers because it does not yet exist and its addition must coincide atomically with inventory.mjs/test-inventory tightening; connectors/meta-ads-mcp/ defers because formal classification (exclude-pin + exact-bijection inventory tightening) must land atomically with cli/'s addition under the single AM-43 ruling and the newly-landed discriminating verifier — splitting AM-43's activation across two PRs would be incoherent with AM-43's indivisible ruling. Phase A is unaffected: package-roots.json remains byte-unchanged on its AM-42 pin, all pre-existing verify-contracts + test-inventory gates remain green at the Phase A head, and the pre-activation slice whitelist is unchanged per Eye ruling. AM-42's file bytes are never touched; all amendment/regularization linkage lives solely in mutable registry surfaces and new records. No other obligation, whitelist entry, or package classification is silently altered. The inherited AMENDMENT-1 content is sound: the E1-E6 enforcement chain is fail-closed and addresses all v0.2.0 blockers; the two-phase pivot correctly resolves DISCOVERY-001's bootstrap-pivot coupling; the carried-forward spikes (SPIKE-E6-EVALUATOR-FORM with declarative-oracle-language settled design and pre-evaluator enrollment blocked, SPIKE-PD001-NOLISTENER-COMPLETENESS with kernel-inherited seccomp architecture conceptually sound and CI eBPF+strace detection fail-closed) are bounded with explicit interim postures and Eye-ratified; honest limits and non-claims are accurately stated. The plan is implementation-ready and consistent with the repository trust model.
